crossRefs.note: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
“Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak.…
Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…
Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands…
Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.
Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ…

translations.web: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
translations.bsb: “Call out if you please, but who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
translations.kjv: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
translations.asv: Call now; is there any that will answer thee? And to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?
